Scenario:

Someone makes a twitter-like bot that has a simple code that pulls information at random from 3 or 4 sources:

  • One source are all the known emails released with parts redacted.
  • One source is anything published anywhere within the public sphere, in english (or not), excluding hillary emails
  • One source is random numbers
  • and finally, one source contains all the unredacted emails known to contain classified or higher information found in HRC emails.

Now, let's assume everyone involved is working toward the goal of making this "bot" compartmentalized and totally in the dark regarding what the end result will be. Best example I can think of is the movie, The Cube, 1997.

So one person might simply be creating any random program that scrapes websites and dumps the information into a *.rtf file. Another person might work on creating a RNG algorythm to produce as random a selection as possible. And still, another might simply hire the webhost.

In anycase, we assume no single person involved as any knowledge of what the end product or service will be. The people who have some idea what the bot can do, only know the widest of paramaters and those with absolute knowledge of the end product, will have no idea how to produce the affect, and more importantly, no access to the materials in question (this is a mind exercise).

So, when this thing goes online and starts spitting out information on SAPs which have already leaked via Clinton and other information published in the public domain, will the FBI and Comey still find no intent? A computer can't formulate intent, no single person in the chain has intent. No one in the chain could even be called negligent.

Some how I don't think the ABC agencies would fail to find someone responsible. I doubt anyone involved would be spared prison, yet the information published is available only because of Clinton, and only because he directly made the materials available.

So I have to wonder:

  • Would people who mishandle already published and mishandled materials be held to a higher standard then the person or people who caused the materials to be leaked and published?
  • What would Obama's response be given his record with current whistle-blowers?
  • What actions would constitute the threshold for establishing intent?
  • IS it possible to have any law on the books regarding classified materials using the threshold for intent Comey used w/ Clinton?

[edit] we could even go further and explore the option of a team creating an AI bot like @tay who happens to tweet or publish these materials at random, or becomes obsessed with publishing the materials for w/e unforeseen reason.
